title: Scope Copilot agent instructions via .github/instructions/*.instructions.md frontmatter
answers: How do I add instructions only for the Copilot cloud agent?
How to exclude the code-review agent from repository custom instructions
Where do path-specific Copilot custom instructions live in this repo?
Why does my Copilot instruction file apply to every file or every agent?
body:
Convention: agent-specific guidance goes in `.github/instructions/<name>.instructions.md`, not in the root `AGENTS.md`-style files.
Frontmatter controls scope: `applyTo` sets the file glob (`"**"` = all paths) and `excludeAgent` names the agent to skip (`"code-review"` keeps the file away from the code-review agent).
The cloud-agent file is `.github/instructions/cloud-agent.instructions.md`; it currently only has a `## Pull request descriptions` section.
Keep new cloud-agent rules in that file rather than adding a second file with overlapping `applyTo` globs, so the scope stays in one place.
Constraints: the frontmatter keys follow GitHub's Copilot custom-instruction format; this repo's diff does not show any test or script that validates them.
applies: Editing or adding Copilot/agent instruction files under .github/instructions/ in this repository.
says: Custom repository instructions are running on the automated code review bot instead of cloud assistant.
Configure repository assistant guidelines that only apply when generating pull request descriptions.
Prevent automated review agents from picking up instructions intended solely for cloud tasks.
Why do custom repository rules apply to every automated assistant across the entire codebase?
search: Copilot agent instructions must be scoped using frontmatter in .github/instructions/*.instructions.md rather than root instruction files. Frontmatter keys applyTo and excludeAgent control the file glob and which agent to skip, such as excluding the code-review agent. Guidance for the cloud agent belongs in .github/instructions/cloud-agent.instructions.md under pull request descriptions to keep scopes consolidated, following GitHub Copilot custom instruction formatting without repository test validation.
